_about: The woman's fat thickness per zone, and the declared depths that place muscle and the trunk's cavity, for tools/body_layers.py. Set by eye, not measured (initiative tissue-research). fat_deep_share: the part of the fat that is its deep layer, per zone, by eye; a zone left out has one layer. Edit to change the defaults; a run can override one as fat.<zone>=mm or structure.<name>=value.
